reviews.text: Naomi is just amazing! We have a nervous nail cutting boy & we worked with naomi over a couple of visits. We used her training suggestions and now he has no problem! When we walk past on non grooming days both dogs are trying to go in to see her. That's a real testament to her love for dogs & their love for her.

Thank you so much Barkside Grooms for doing an amazing job on our little chuhauhau Teddy! He was so happy to leave us and go get his first grooming session. He had the full treatment. Wash, trim, claws clipped and ears cleaned.
Would definitely recommend to anyone who is looking for a dog groomer!. It was a pleasure to take him there, such a lovely service was provided I will be going back to say the least. Thank you so much from myself and Teddy

First time using this groomer for our Scottish deerhound, Dante, we are so pleased with the outcome, he looks amazing, and boy did he need it. We could tell that everything went really well, as he was totally chilled when we picked him up, which is a credit to Naomi (hopefully spelt it right) thank you so much, will will 100%recommend you, and thank you for adding his photo to your website 😊
Naomi made Ivy feel so welcome, she can be quite an anxious dog. She smells so lovely and her fur is now soft and fluffy. Truly pampered 😊 …

Just used The Barkside Grooms for the first time, thrilled with how well my two pooches have been groomed and looked after, Top Job!!!

Stef n Tash

We cannot recommend Naomi enough!
She gave our 18 month GSD his first groom & he came back more handsome than ever. Great communication & good prices. We will defo be booking again for his next groom.
Thank you for the 5 stars, Mick!
My go to groomer, she’s super lovely, really good with our dog, always happy with the groom too!

Alfie has found his forever groomer at Barkside Grooms. Struggling with matted fur Alfie was in desperate need for a fresh cut. I was provided with a lot of help and advice on how to deal with his fur in the future and what styles/cuts are best for his specific fur type. The most important thing though is that Alfie enjoyed his time and was given all the time in the world leading to a very happy pup. Thank you Barkside Grooms for your care and attention to detail.

BELLA went for a full groom at backside grooms , I was so nervous due to her being a giant breed DDB and a giddy one , but they made her feel at home , and even managed her ears which I've been trying for months,  very friendly and professional great communication,  she smelt lovely and was so soft , ❤️  thank you
Really pleasant, calm and friendly owner who managed to put both my dog and me (both noobs) at ease. Very pleased with the cut & groom. Will return.

Brilliant grooming of our Cockapoo
Naomi efficient, fast and friendly
Highly recommended!!
Very poor service , had to retake my dog to other groomer Barkside would not at all recommend  at all

When we got our nervous rescue from abroad he was covered in mats and had fleas. I was really nervous taking him somewhere new so soon but I could tell he was miserable and The Barkside Grooms came highly recommended by many people in a FB …

Booked my cocker spaniel Luca in for a groom with Naomi, I have been searching a long time for a groomer around leeds that could cut my show type how I wanted and Naomi absolutely exceeded what I wanted! I am over the moon with the groom …

Took Mimi for her first haircut with barkside grooms today as they were recommended, so glad they were as Naomi fit her in literally straight away wich was perfect, Mimi looks amazing after her cut and smells amazing too haha. Naomi’s done a fantastic job, will definitely be going here for mimis future grooms. Thank you so much x

I was on the look out for a groomer and saw Naomi mentioned. I am so glad i gave her a try i left my scraggy looking labradoodle and picked up a perfectly groomed doggy. The cut was just what I asked for and Dougie seemed to like it. I will definitely be a returning customer.
